Special Population Groups 
 
* Paediatric: may present with more non-specific or atypical symptoms. 
* Pregnancy: due to displacement of the uterus, presentation may be atypical. 
A leukocytosis in pregnancy is normal. 
* Elderly: do not mount the usual inflammatory response. The usual signs & symptoms 
of appendicitis may be reduced, atypical or even absent. Tend to present later. 
* Immunocompromised: do not mount the usual inflammatory response.
